replies.rawMarkdown:
There are no rerun at end of competition. Your final score is already computed but will stay hidden till end of competition.

There are 100 game sin test data. 55 are used to compute the score shown on public LB during the competition. 55 are used to compute a hidden score that will be used for final ranking if you select that submission.

firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hi all, 
Given the change in accelerators from H100s to RTX 6000, and because we want to make sure your models still have ample resource headroom to run successfully on the new hardware, we have adjusted the code requirements and extended the maximum notebook runtime. It has increased from 6 hours to 9 hours. I noted this on the Overview tab, in the section [Code requirements](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/arc-prize-2026-arc-agi-3/overview/code-requirements). 

Thank you everyone for your patience as we worked through this challenge. 

Happy modeling, and good luck!

María
